text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото wins the Japanese Derby,
surpassing
Адмайр Вега. But unlike her
competitor, there is
no one to whom she
can dedicate this star of
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Адмайр Вега respectfully takes her
leave. As
Мэйсё Дото watches, she
dreams of one day
finding someone to
run for.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
